description: Hosley Set of 24 Clear Chunky Thick Glass Votive / Tealight (Wax or LED) Candle Holders- 2.4" High. Suitable for Tealight candle / Votive Candle / LED Tealight Candle / LED Votive Candle. Hosley's tealight candles will add a touch of elegance to your special event, home decor or romantic dinner while creating a subtle and warm ambiance. Our tealight candles make the perfect gift for any occasion. Hosley's tealight candles will allow you to have a wonderful opportunity in bringing new fragrances into your home. Whether you are looking for a colored fraganced tealight or a white unscented tealight, Hosley's candles will compliment existing decor along with adding a perfect centerpiece to your special event. Hosley candles are equally well suited for to a variety of indoor and outdoor uses, including emergency power outages or simply providing warm, ambient light. Be sure to keep your emergency kit stocked with extra Hosley candles. To maximize the burn of your candle, we suggest trimming and maintaining the wick to 1/8”. Trimming the wick helps maintain an even burn and helps keep the flame from getting too close to the glass. As a general rule, we also suggest using for no more than 4 hours at a time to maximize the burn duration. Always use on heat/flame resistant surface and burn within sight. Keep away from things that can catch fire and away from children and pets. Always keep the wax pool clear of wick trimmings, matches and debris at all times. Product may come in a different package.
